• 12+ years
of technology delivery/program/project management experience
• 5+ years
leading large-scale technical programs for enterprise clients

• Experience managing globally distributed delivery teams
• Proven experience managing a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects

Experience in Utilities, Energy, or other regulated and infrastructure-heavy industries

This role requires 5 days onsite in Columbus, Ohio

jobs.title: Head of Product Engineering (Large Power Transformers)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Head of Product Engineering will join the founding team to lead all design, materials, and manufacturability initiatives for Terminus’ transformer product line. This role will define the company’s technical DNA — translating years of power-engineering know-how into modern, automated, and scalable production.

This is a critical leadership role, responsible for architecting Terminus’ first generation of 50–600 MVA power transformers, establishing internal design standards, and integrating advanced design tools (CAD, FEA, digital twins) with manufacturing automation.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design Leadership: Lead end-to-end electrical and mechanical design of LPTs (core, windings, tank, OLTC, bushings, cooling, insulation systems).
Design for Manufacturability: Translate design requirements into scalable manufacturing workflows optimized for automation, repeatability, and quality.
System Integration: Define and validate electrical, thermal, acoustic and mechanical performance parameters for 50–600 MVA, 69–345-kV transformers.
FoundationOS Platform: Provide your subject matter expertise to the CTO to aid in the buildout and factory integration of Terminus Industrials’ proprietary power transformer design platform “FoundationOS” — ingesting customer specifications from Purchase Orders and translating them into manufacturable electromechanical designs, BOM, and CAD models.
Toolchain Development: Implement advanced modeling and simulation environments with the Digital Infrastructure team (e.g., Fusion, SolidWorks, COMSOL, ANSYS Maxwell, EMTP-RV).
Compliance & Standards: Ensure adherence to IEEE, ANSI, IEC, DOE, and utility specifications; lead design qualification and type testing programs.
Supplier & Utility Interface: Support technical engagement with utilities, EPCs, and component vendors (core steel, windings, insulation, bushings, OLTC, etc.).
Team Building: Recruit, mentor, and grow the core transformer design and product-engineering team.

Desired Qualifications

10+ years of experience in power transformer design/manufacturing, preferably at Doble Engineering, Siemens Energy, ABB/Hitachi Energy, GE Grid Solutions/GE Prolec/Waukesha, Virginia Transformer, Pennsylvania Transformer, WEG, or a major utility (NextEra Energy, AEP, Oncor, etc.) or major EPC (Burns & McDonnell, Black & Veatch, etc.).
Deep understanding of core/winding design, insulation coordination, dielectric testing, loss optimization, and thermal management.
Proficiency with transformer design software (e.g., EFACE, Flux, ANSYS Maxwell, COMSOL, or in-house proprietary tools).
Strong grasp of Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and familiarity with automated or semi-automated production methods.
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems focus); PhD or PE license preferred.
U.S. citizenship or permanent residency (due to defense-grade program requirements).

Job Summary

The Head of Business Development is a senior, hands-on seller and early commercial leader responsible for turning market demand into qualified customer commitments. This is initially an individual-contributor role, which is expected to evolve into leading Terminus commercial team. The role is remote in the U.S., with regular travel to the Terminus office, customers, industry events, and Central Texas.

This person will inherit Terminus’s active pipeline and personally originate, qualify, advance, and negotiate opportunities across Terminus core customer groups, which include credit worthy private developers and major transmission utilities. The role covers account development and technical discovery through proposals, customer qualification, commercial negotiation, and definitive purchase agreements. Working across engineering, manufacturing, finance, legal, and partnerships, this person will build customer trust, align demand with product and future capacity, and establish a repeatable sales process. Ultimately, this role is responsible for converting customer demand into bankable offtake agreements, and with success determined by the credit-worthiness of customer-backed commitments, signed reservations, forecast accuracy, and relationship management from order to unit delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Pipeline Ownership: Own the commercial plan, account priorities, and full opportunity pipeline; establish clear stage and qualification standards; maintain a forecast by units, GVA, indicative value, delivery need, probability, and next action; and remain accountable for qualified demand, signed reservations, and eventual orders.
Account Origination & Executive Relationships: Build senior relationships across investor-owned and public utilities, cooperatives, power producers and developers, data centers and other large-load customers, EPCs, and engineering firms; originate business through direct outreach, referrals, conferences, RFQs, representatives, and strategic partners.
Technical Discovery, Qualification & Market Entry: Lead early requirements capture for application, voltage, MVA, quantity, configuration, delivery window, standards, site, and transportation constraints; partner with engineering on product fit; and navigate approved-vendor, factory-audit, testing, and new-manufacturer qualification processes for both private customers and utilities.
RFQs, Proposals & Commercial Execution: Own bid/no-bid decisions and coordinate RFI, RFQ, RFP, indicative-pricing, and proposal responses; convert qualified interest into technically supportable Production Slot Reservation Agreements; lead commercial and legal negotiations; and drive the path toward definitive purchase agreements.
Customer Stewardship & Cross-Functional Alignment: Remain the executive commercial owner after signature; coordinate progress updates, technical reviews, facility diligence, and qualification-readiness evidence; communicate milestones and risk candidly; and translate customer demand into product, pricing, capacity, factory-planning, and financing decisions.
Commercial Systems, Market Presence & Team Building: Build disciplined CRM, forecasting, follow-up, proposal, pricing-approval, and account-review processes; maintain accurate customer data and competitive intelligence; represent Terminus at industry events; manage external representatives; personally run the commercial cadence today; and help recruit and lead a lean commercial team as demand and capacity justify it.

Required Qualifications

Typically 10+ years of customer-facing sales or business development experience involving complex, engineered, capital-intensive products or infrastructure.
A record of personally originating, qualifying, advancing, and winning multi-million-dollar, long-cycle opportunities. Candidates should be able to explain their individual role, deal size, sales cycle, obstacles, and outcome.
Experience selling to utilities, power producers or developers, data-center or other large-load developers, industrial customers, EPCs, engineering firms, or similarly sophisticated buyers.
Strong consultative selling ability, including gaining access to senior and technical stakeholders, uncovering customer requirements, building internal champions, and keeping complex opportunities moving toward a defined next step.
Sufficient technical aptitude to discuss applications, specifications, lead times, qualification requirements, and commercial tradeoffs with engineering and procurement teams, with the ability to learn transformer-specific products and standards quickly.
Disciplined pipeline management, including strong CRM habits, realistic forecasting, proposal coordination, commercial negotiation, written communication, and consistent follow-through.
Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in a development-stage company, working across engineering, manufacturing, finance, and legal, and traveling regularly for customer meetings and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience selling large or medium power transformers, high-voltage equipment, substations, switchgear, grid infrastructure, power-generation equipment, or similarly complex electrical equipment.
Experience with a regional or specialty equipment manufacturer, independent representative or distributor, EPC, transformer service or remanufacturing company, or power or data-center developer.
Familiarity with utility supplier qualification, factory audits, IEEE or ANSI standards, factory acceptance testing, RFQs and RFPs, and heavy-equipment transportation constraints.
Existing relationships across North American utility, power-generation, EPC, data-center, or industrial markets.
Experience launching a new manufacturer, product line, or territory; building sales processes; and managing external representatives or a small commercial team.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Alto Sur Capital Partners operates in the venture capital and private equity sector, partnering with growth-focused companies and innovative founders. The firm specializes in identifying high-potential investments, providing strategic guidance, and supporting portfolio companies through key stages of expansion. Team members collaborate closely with leadership teams to drive value creation, enhance operational performance, and optimize long-term returns. The environment is fast-paced, analytical, and entrepreneurial, offering opportunities to influence both technology and business outcomes.

Role Description

The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote role responsible for shaping and executing Alto Sur Capital Partners’ technology vision across the firm and its portfolio companies. This role includes developing and refining IT strategy, evaluating technology platforms and tools, and advising on digital transformation initiatives. Day-to-day responsibilities involve partnering with investment and operations teams to assess technology risks and opportunities, conducting technical due diligence, and recommending scalable solutions for portfolio companies. The role also oversees technology roadmaps, coordinates cross-functional projects, and ensures alignment between business objectives and technology investments. The Vice President of Technology will regularly communicate with internal stakeholders and portfolio leadership, provide thought leadership on emerging technologies, and establish best practices for information security, data management, and IT governance.

Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret complex data, evaluate technology investments, and support due diligence processes.
Deep expertise in Information Technology, with experience overseeing enterprise systems, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and infrastructure.
Proven capability in IT Strategy, including developing technology roadmaps, aligning IT initiatives with business goals, and guiding digital transformation.
Demonstrated Project Management experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, managing timelines, and delivering results.
Solid Strategic Planning skills, including long-term technology forecasting, budget planning, and portfolio-level technology prioritization.
Experience working in or with venture capital, private equity, or high-growth companies is highly beneficial.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, cloud certifications) are a plus.
Ability to thrive in a remote, distributed environment, demonstrating self-direction, collaboration, and accountability.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering – Acute Devices
jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

As the Global Software Leader for Acute Products/ Devices, this role is responsible for leading multi-site device software engineering team for Acute Care products by defining and driving software strategy and implementation and delivering to all Acute Care product lines. As the Global Device Software Leader for Acute Care product lines of Vantive, works in collaboration with commercial, systems, program management, Quality & Regulatory functional leadership teams to build and execute on product strategy, roadmaps and delivery plans.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own product-line software strategy and roadmaps for device software for all acute products; aligning with business and product strategy and therapy needs.
Lead Acute global device software team, including functional managers and technical leaders.
Lead defining and implementing technology and software architecture strategy working with Acute device software leaders and in collaboration with systems leaders
Lead Acute global device software team in building execution plans and driving execution to deliver to the product roadmaps and releases across all Acute product lines.
Create, effectively communicate, and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and customer needs.
Establish an organization structure that ensures clear accountability and operational excellence.
Develop and mentor high-performing managers and technical leaders; build succession plans and communities of practice across global sites.
Provide strategic planning leadership for resource staffing and project execution with proactive management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments
Leverages deep knowledge of technology/process/therapy domains, user needs, hazards, risk, and business targets and budgets to drive solutions and product design realization.
Management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments.
Drive post-market software change management strategy, field data analytics, and reliability improvements with contained risk and minimal therapy disruption.
Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement.
Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant Quality System Regulations and other regulatory requirements related to research and development (medical product development, design, safety, Cyber Security) to ensure compliance in all research, development, data collection and reporting activities.

Qualifications

Significant experience in Electro-mechanical devices and device software engineering.
Understanding of global regulatory requirements for medical devices; risk and reliability concepts for development; and the need to deliver quality products and/or processes.
Significant experience leading a globally distributed team and working in a global matrix environment.
Strong team building and talent management skills, and the ability to motivate team members to achieve goals.
Proven experience in driving product specific and overall portfolio strategy, specific to software technology, in a global business.
Must possess strong knowledge of scientific/technical disciplines and solid knowledge of related disciplines such as regulatory, quality, and/or product development.
Recognized internally and externally as expert in functional area.
Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills.
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across Clinical, RA/QA, Systems, Operations, and suppliers.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in electrical/computer/software engineering (Master’s preferred). Experience in medical devices or other safety‑critical electromechanical domains (e.g., aerospace, industrial controls, automotive) required; medical device experience strongly preferred.

The Head of Product Engineering will join the founding team to lead all design, materials, and manufacturability initiatives for Terminus’ transformer product line. new_jobs.title: Vice President Information Technology
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Walk On Ventures (WOV) is a strategic growth advisory and venture firm partnering with founders and executive teams who are building high-impact companies. Operating at the intersection of performance marketing, insurtech, and agentic AI, WOV helps organizations scale and achieve outcomes faster. The firm embeds directly with leadership teams, providing real operating experience and high-impact partnership instead of generic frameworks. WOV focuses on accelerating growth, increasing enterprise value, and supporting organizations through complexity and capital events. The “Walk On Mentality” emphasizes preparation, resilience, and performance in service of every client, every day.

Role Description

The Vice President Information Technology is a full-time remote role responsible for leading WOV’s technology vision and execution across internal operations and client-facing initiatives. This position oversees IT strategy, architecture, and roadmaps to ensure secure, scalable, and resilient systems that support performance marketing, insurtech, and agentic AI solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include directing IT operations, managing enterprise applications and infrastructure, governing data and information security, and aligning technology investments with business priorities. The role leads cross-functional technology projects, coordinates with advisory and venture teams, and evaluates emerging technologies that can drive growth and operating leverage. The Vice President Information Technology also builds and mentors IT teams, establishes standards and policies, and ensures reliable, compliant technology environments for WOV and its portfolio companies.

Qualifications

Broad Information Technology expertise across infrastructure, cloud services, enterprise applications, and security.
Demonstrated IT Management experience, including leading teams, vendors, budgets, and complex technology environments.
Proven ability to define and execute IT Strategy that aligns with organizational goals and supports scalable growth.
Strong Project Management skills for planning, prioritizing, and delivering cross-functional technology initiatives.
Strategic Planning capabilities to translate business needs into long-term technology roadmaps and investment plans.
Experience with performance marketing, insurtech, data platforms, and AI-enabled solutions is highly beneficial.
Background in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments such as startups, scale-ups, or advisory/consulting firms.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively at the executive level.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP, CISSP, cloud certifications) are a plus.

new_jobs.title: Head of Markets Data & Risk Technology, Managing Director, Onsite
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior technology executive with a demonstrated track record of delivering large-scale Markets initiatives and building market-leading technology organizations. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and the ability to formulate, influence, and execute a strategic technology vision that delivers measurable business outcomes.

This leader will be responsible for driving innovation, engineering excellence, data and risk transformation, and technology modernization across Markets. They will partner closely with senior business and technology leaders to define and execute a shared target-state architecture, enhance client and business outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and create sustainable competitive advantage through technology.

The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, execution-focused, intellectually curious, and passionate about developing talent and building high-performing teams. They operate with integrity, transparency, and accountability, while fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement.

Due to the role requirements this job needs to be performed primarily in the office with some flex work opportunities available.

Strategic Leadership

Accountable for the overall strategy, delivery, and operation of Markets IT Data & Risk Technology.
Develop and execute a multi-year technology vision aligned with Markets business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
Partner with Markets leadership to drive growth, profitability, risk management, client satisfaction, and operational excellence through technology.
Participate in Markets strategic planning, investment prioritization, and operating model decisions.

Data, Risk & Analytics Platform Leadership

Define and execute the target architecture for market, counterparty, liquidity, and regulatory risk platforms.
Lead the evolution of enterprise data platforms supporting front-office, risk, regulatory, research, and analytics use cases.
Drive adoption of modern data architecture, cloud-native technologies, real-time analytics, and AI-enabled decision support capabilities.
Establish robust data governance, lineage, quality, metadata management, and controls to support regulatory and business requirements.
Deliver scalable solutions that provide accurate, timely, and actionable risk intelligence across asset classes.

Engineering & Technology Transformation

Drive engineering excellence through modern software development practices, automation, platform engineering, and continuous delivery.
Lead modernization efforts across applications, infrastructure, and data platforms to improve resiliency, scalability, security, and time-to-market.
Balance proprietary development, vendor platforms, open-source technologies, and strategic partnerships to maximize business value.
Champion architecture simplification, reuse, standardization, and technical debt reduction across the Markets technology estate.

Innovation & Business Enablement

Identify and create opportunities for new products, services, and client capabilities through technology innovation.
Leverage AI, machine learning, agentic workflows, advanced analytics, and automation to enhance productivity, reduce risk, and increase operating leverage.
Foster a culture of experimentation through proofs of concept, rapid prototyping, and iterative delivery.
Translate emerging technology trends into practical business solutions and competitive differentiation.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Excellence

Ensure technology solutions meet evolving regulatory, compliance, cybersecurity, resiliency, and operational risk standards.
Drive strong technology governance, platform reliability, business continuity, and operational excellence practices.
Partner with Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Data Governance teams to ensure appropriate controls and transparency across critical platforms.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Build, attract, retain, and develop world-class engineering, architecture, and data talent globally.
Drive workforce optimization, productivity, succession planning, career development, and technical skill advancement.
Establish a high-performance culture characterized by accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
Lead geographically distributed teams through organizational change and transformation initiatives.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Superior engineering leadership coupled with strong business understanding.
Proven ability to define and execute a compelling technology vision in complex global organizations.
Deep expertise in Markets technology, market structure, risk platforms, and data ecosystems.
Strong understanding of front-office workflows, risk management processes, and post-trade operations.
Ability to influence senior executives and build consensus across business, risk, operations, and technology stakeholders.
Demonstrated record of delivering complex programs with measurable business impact.
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to convert ideas into production capabilities and business value.
Outstanding communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Bias for action, ownership, and results while maintaining high standards of governance and control.
Commitment to integrity, transparency, and leadership through example.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressively increasing leadership responsibility within financial services technology.
Significant experience leading large-scale Markets IT, Risk, Data, or Front Office technology organizations.
Deep knowledge of fixed income, FX, equities, derivatives, financing, securities lending, and related market infrastructure.
Proven expertise in market data, risk analytics, regulatory reporting, data management, and cloud technologies.
Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of proprietary applications, vendor platforms, and strategic technology partnerships.
Experience leading global teams and managing substantial technology budgets and investment portfolios.
Strong understanding of modern architecture patterns, distributed systems, AI/ML platforms, cloud computing, platform engineering, and cybersecurity.
Track record of building high-performing organizations and developing future technology leaders.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Measured On

Growth of Markets business capabilities through technology.
Delivery of strategic transformation goals and target-state architecture.
Improvement in productivity, operational efficiency, and platform resiliency.
Increased reuse, standardization, and reduction of technical debt.
Adoption of AI and automation to improve business outcomes.
Talent attraction, retention, development, and organizational health.
Strong risk management, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence

Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

Why this role is important to us

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

Salary Range

$170,000 - $282,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home .

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
